gloss: poster; contributor; person who submits a post or article

definitions.gloss: poster; contributor; person who submits a post, comment, or article
definitions.explanation: The person who writes and submits a post, comment, photo, or article to a magazine, newspaper, bulletin board, blog, or social media platform. Originally used of readers contributing to print publications; now the default word for someone who posts content online.

examples.japanese: {投稿者|とうこうしゃ}の{名前|なまえ}は{伏|ふ}せられている。
examples.english: The poster's name has been withheld.

examples.japanese: この{写真|しゃしん}の{投稿者|とうこうしゃ}は{北海道|ほっかいどう}{在住|ざいじゅう}らしい。
examples.english: The person who posted this photo apparently lives in Hokkaido.

examples.japanese: {運営|うんえい}{側|がわ}は{悪質|あくしつ}なコメントを{繰|く}り{返|かえ}す{投稿者|とうこうしゃ}のアカウントを{凍結|とうけつ}することにした。
examples.english: The management decided to freeze the accounts of posters who repeatedly made malicious comments.

notes:
Compound of {投稿|とうこう} ('to post; to submit a contribution') and {者|しゃ} ('person'). A {投稿者|とうこうしゃ} is literally 'one who posts'.

USAGE:
- Neutral term with no positive or negative connotation on its own; context usually supplies the evaluation (e.g., {悪質|あくしつ}な{投稿者|とうこうしゃ} 'malicious poster', {常連|じょうれん}{投稿者|とうこうしゃ} 'regular contributor').
- Appears on websites and in apps as a generic label for the author of a piece of user-generated content (photo, review, comment, question).
- When referring to one's own post, speakers use {自分|じぶん} or {私|わたし} rather than calling themselves {投稿者|とうこうしゃ}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {投稿者|とうこうしゃ}の{名前|なまえ}: the poster's name
- {投稿者|とうこうしゃ}{本人|ほんにん}: the poster himself/herself
- {投稿者|とうこうしゃ}を{特定|とくてい}する: to identify the poster
- {匿名|とくめい}の{投稿者|とうこうしゃ}: anonymous poster
- {常連|じょうれん}{投稿者|とうこうしゃ}: regular contributor

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {投稿|とうこう}する: to post; to submit — the verb the noun is derived from.
- {寄稿者|きこうしゃ}: contributor (to a magazine or publication) — more formal; used of writers invited to submit articles to a specific publication.
- {発信者|はっしんしゃ}: sender; originator (of a message or information) — broader, covering anyone who sends or emits a communication.
- ユーザー: user — covers anyone using a service; narrower than {投稿者|とうこうしゃ} since not all users post content.
